title: Preview a policy migration
notice: This changes learning policy, not tool budgets. Existing anchors/windows, scope identities, pools, grants and ledger history must be preserved. The server computes concrete impacts before authorizing a migration.
syntax.array: Expected an array of complete scope definitions.
affected: {reserved} reserved work items are affected. {offers} outstanding offers will be superseded and need fresh learner consent. Pool definitions and existing grants are unchanged.
reviewed: I reviewed this exact migration, its affected work and superseded offers.
